title: Choose the First Artifact visual world
question: The Proof Wall is the assigned direction. Keep it, take a challenger, steer the hand, or re-roll.

options.label: The Proof Wall
options.lineage: print-shop maker's proofs and approval sheets
options.thesis: Membership is a wall of evidence: nothing enters without a real artifact.
options.viewport: A wall-sized red-and-white proof sheet leads with FIRST ARTIFACT, OBSESSION BEATS TALENT, five member proofs, and a SUBMIT YOUR PROOF action.
options.risk: It can feel bureaucratic if approval marks overpower the playful maker energy.

options.label: The Scene Bulletin
options.thesis: The club feels like a living independent publication made by its members.
options.case: Audience identification: high. Product clarity: strong, but admission evidence is less immediate than the Proof Wall.
options.viewport: Issue 001 opens as a red-and-white bulletin with FIRST ARTIFACT, OBSESSION BEATS TALENT, member bylines, and an APPLY TO THE NEXT ISSUE action.
options.risk: Its editorial energy may make the admission standard feel like taste rather than evidence.

options.label: The Night Shift Garage
options.thesis: Obsession is endurance: members prove they can keep building through the long night.
options.case: Audience identification: medium-high. Product clarity: medium because the racing metaphor competes with the admission mechanism.
options.viewport: A red-white-black garage bill leads with BUILT FOR THE LONG NIGHT, five member roundels, and an ENTER QUALIFYING application action.
options.risk: Racing culture can narrow the community signal and needs imagery the project does not yet own.

options.label: The Always-On Circuit
options.lineage: hand-bent neon as one continuous circuit
options.thesis: Obsession becomes an unbroken current connecting every builder and artifact.
options.case: Audience identification: high. Product clarity: medium; it fuses poorly because its dark glow system fights the approved red-white identity.
options.viewport: FIRST ARTIFACT runs as one luminous circuit above OBSESSION BEATS TALENT, with five member nodes and an ACTIVATE APPLICATION control.
options.risk: It can slip into familiar neon-tech nightlife and hide the shipped-work standard.

canonCard.label: The polished members club
canonCard.thesis: A clean exclusive-tech-community landing page with member portraits and a direct application CTA.
canonCard.viewport: A conventional navigation bar, split hero, member grid, benefits, criteria, and application form in a familiar reading order.
canonCard.risk: Highly legible and trustworthy, but easy to confuse with every other selective founder community.
